id-20261014-news-2.title: Nonsubsidized Fuel Prices and World Oil Above US$100: How Pertamina Determines Prices and the Impact on Citizens' Pockets

segments.src: Setiap awal bulan, banyak pengendara menunggu satu hal: apakah harga BBM nonsubsidi naik, turun, atau tetap.
segments.tr: Every beginning of the month, many drivers wait for one thing: whether non-subsidized fuel prices go up, down, or stay the same.

segments.src: Ketika harga minyak mentah dunia, termasuk Brent, bertahan di level tinggi, perhatian publik terhadap penyesuaian harga ini pun meningkat.
segments.tr: When world crude oil prices, including Brent, remain at high levels, public attention to this price adjustment also increases.

segments.src: Artikel ini menjelaskan secara ringkas bagaimana harga BBM ditentukan, apa bedanya BBM subsidi dan nonsubsidi, serta bagaimana perubahan harga bisa merambat ke ongkos transportasi dan harga barang.
segments.tr: This article briefly explains how fuel prices are determined, what the difference is between subsidized and non-subsidized fuel, and how price changes can ripple into transportation costs and goods prices.

segments.src: > Catatan: Artikel ini bersifat informasi umum dan edukasi, bukan nasihat keuangan. Angka harga dapat berubah sewaktu-waktu, sehingga selalu rujuk pengumuman resmi operator SPBU atau pemerintah.
segments.tr: > Note: This article is for general information and educational purposes, not financial advice. Price figures may change at any time, so always refer to official announcements from gas station operators or the government.

segments.src: ## Mengapa Harga Minyak Dunia Berpengaruh?
segments.tr: ## Why Do World Oil Prices Matter?

segments.src: Indonesia masih mengimpor sebagian kebutuhan minyak mentah dan BBM.
segments.tr: Indonesia still imports some of its crude oil and fuel needs.

segments.src: Karena itu, harga di pasar global menjadi salah satu acuan utama.
segments.tr: Therefore, prices in the global market become one of the main references.

segments.src: Brent adalah salah satu patokan harga minyak internasional yang paling banyak dirujuk.
segments.tr: Brent is one of the most widely referenced international oil price benchmarks.

segments.src: Ketika Brent naik dan bertahan tinggi, biaya pengadaan bahan baku BBM ikut meningkat.
segments.tr: When Brent rises and stays high, the cost of procuring fuel raw materials also increases.

segments.src: Selain harga minyak, faktor lain turut memengaruhi harga jual di SPBU, antara lain:
segments.tr: Apart from oil prices, other factors also influence selling prices at gas stations, including:

segments.src: - **Kurs rupiah terhadap dolar AS.** Pembelian minyak umumnya memakai dolar, sehingga pelemahan rupiah menambah beban biaya.
segments.tr: - **The exchange rate of the rupiah against the US dollar.** Oil purchases generally use dollars, so a weakening rupiah adds to the cost burden.

segments.src: - **Biaya pengolahan, distribusi, dan penyimpanan.**
segments.tr: - **Processing, distribution, and storage costs.**

segments.src: - **Pajak dan pungutan**, seperti pajak pertambahan nilai dan pajak bahan bakar kendaraan bermotor.
segments.tr: - **Taxes and levies**, such as value-added tax and motor vehicle fuel tax.

segments.src: - **Margin badan usaha** untuk operasional SPBU.
segments.tr: - **Business entity margins** for gas station operations.

segments.src: ## Bagaimana Pertamina Menetapkan Harga BBM Nonsubsidi?
segments.tr: ## How Does Pertamina Set Non-Subsidized Fuel Prices?

segments.src: BBM nonsubsidi, seperti Pertamax series, Dexlite, dan Pertamina Dex, harga jualnya mengikuti mekanisme pasar dalam batas ketentuan pemerintah.
segments.tr: Non-subsidized fuel, such as the Pertamax series, Dexlite, and Pertamina Dex, has its selling price follow market mechanisms within the limits of government provisions.

segments.src: Secara umum, harga dihitung dari beberapa komponen:
segments.tr: In general, prices are calculated from several components:

segments.src: 1. **Harga dasar**, yang mengacu pada indeks harga produk BBM di pasar internasional dan kurs.
segments.tr: 1. **Base price**, which refers to the price index of fuel products in the international market and exchange rates.

segments.src: 2. **Biaya distribusi dan operasional.**
segments.tr: 2. **Distribution and operational costs.**

segments.src: 3. **Pajak dan pungutan** sesuai peraturan.
segments.tr: 3. **Taxes and levies** according to regulations.

segments.src: 4. **Margin** badan usaha.
segments.tr: 4. **Business entity margins**.

segments.src: Pemerintah menetapkan formula batas atas harga eceran untuk jenis BBM tertentu, sehingga badan usaha dapat menyesuaikan harga secara berkala, umumnya sebulan sekali.
segments.tr: The government sets a retail price upper limit formula for certain types of fuel, allowing business entities to adjust prices periodically, generally once a month.

segments.src: Itulah sebabnya pengumuman harga biasanya muncul pada awal bulan.
segments.tr: That is why price announcements usually appear at the beginning of the month.

segments.src: ## Perbedaan BBM Subsidi dan Nonsubsidi
segments.tr: ## Differences Between Subsidized and Non-Subsidized Fuel

segments.src: | Aspek | BBM Subsidi / Penugasan | BBM Nonsubsidi |
segments.tr: | Aspect | Subsidized / Assignment Fuel | Non-Subsidized Fuel |

segments.src: | Penetapan harga | Ditetapkan pemerintah | Mengikuti formula dan kondisi pasar |
segments.tr: | Price setting | Determined by the government | Follows market formula and conditions |

segments.src: | Contoh | Pertalite, Biosolar | Pertamax series, Dexlite, Pertamina Dex |
segments.tr: | Examples | Pertalite, Biosolar | Pertamax series, Dexlite, Pertamina Dex |

segments.src: | Penyesuaian harga | Tidak otomatis, melalui keputusan pemerintah | Dapat berubah berkala |
segments.tr: | Price adjustment | Not automatic, through government decision | Can change periodically |

segments.src: | Sumber selisih biaya | Kompensasi/subsidi dari anggaran negara | Ditanggung harga jual |
segments.tr: | Cost difference source | Compensation/subsidy from the state budget | Borne by the selling price |

segments.src: Pada BBM subsidi atau penugasan, selisih antara harga keekonomian dan harga jual ditanggung melalui mekanisme subsidi dan kompensasi dari anggaran negara.
segments.tr: On subsidized or assignment fuel, the difference between the economic price and the selling price is borne through subsidy and compensation mechanisms from the state budget.

segments.src: Ketika harga minyak tinggi, beban anggaran ikut membesar.
segments.tr: When oil prices are high, the budget burden also grows.

segments.src: Inilah salah satu alasan pemerintah selalu mempertimbangkan keseimbangan antara daya beli masyarakat dan kesehatan fiskal.
segments.tr: This is one of the reasons the government always considers the balance between people's purchasing power and fiscal health.

segments.src: ## Efek Rambatan ke Ongkos Transportasi dan Harga Barang
segments.tr: ## Ripple Effects on Transportation Costs and Goods Prices

segments.src: Perubahan harga BBM, terutama bila berlangsung lama, dapat memberi efek berantai:
segments.tr: Fuel price changes, especially if they last a long time, can have a chain effect:

segments.src: - **Ongkos transportasi.** Biaya angkutan barang dan logistik bergantung pada bahan bakar, terutama solar. Kenaikan biaya ini dapat diteruskan ke tarif.
segments.tr: - **Transportation costs.** Freight and logistics transport costs depend on fuel, especially diesel. This cost increase can be passed on to tariffs.

segments.src: - **Harga barang kebutuhan.** Komoditas yang bergantung pada distribusi jarak jauh, seperti pangan segar, dapat terdampak biaya angkut.
segments.tr: - **Basic goods prices.** Commodities that rely on long-distance distribution, such as fresh food, can be affected by transport costs.

segments.src: - **Pengeluaran rumah tangga.** Pengguna kendaraan pribadi yang memakai BBM nonsubsidi akan merasakan langsung perubahan di SPBU.
segments.tr: - **Household expenditures.** Private vehicle users who use non-subsidized fuel will directly feel the changes at gas stations.

segments.src: - **Inflasi.** Kelompok transportasi dan energi menjadi salah satu komponen yang diamati dalam laporan inflasi.
segments.tr: - **Inflation.** The transportation and energy group is one of the components observed in inflation reports.

segments.src: Besarnya dampak tidak selalu sebanding.
segments.tr: The magnitude of the impact is not always proportional.

segments.src: Banyak faktor lain, seperti pasokan pangan, cuaca, dan kebijakan pemerintah, ikut menentukan harga di tingkat konsumen.
segments.tr: Many other factors, such as food supply, weather, and government policies, help determine prices at the consumer level.

segments.src: ## Tips Mengelola Pengeluaran Bahan Bakar
segments.tr: ## Tips for Managing Fuel Expenses

segments.src: - **Pantau pengumuman resmi** harga BBM tiap awal bulan agar bisa menyesuaikan anggaran.
segments.tr: - **Monitor official announcements** of fuel prices every beginning of the month to adjust your budget.

segments.src: - **Rencanakan perjalanan**: gabungkan beberapa keperluan dalam satu rute.
segments.tr: - **Plan trips**: combine several errands into one route.

segments.src: - **Rawat kendaraan**: tekanan ban yang tepat dan servis berkala membantu efisiensi.
segments.tr: - **Maintain your vehicle**: proper tire pressure and regular servicing help efficiency.

segments.src: - **Gunakan BBM sesuai spesifikasi** kendaraan, sebagaimana rekomendasi pabrikan.
segments.tr: - **Use fuel according to vehicle specifications**, as recommended by the manufacturer.

segments.src: - **Pertimbangkan transportasi umum** untuk perjalanan rutin bila tersedia.
segments.tr: - **Consider public transportation** for routine travel if available.

segments.src: ## Kesimpulan
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: Harga BBM nonsubsidi mencerminkan gabungan harga minyak dunia, kurs, biaya distribusi, pajak, dan margin.
segments.tr: Non-subsidized fuel prices reflect a combination of world oil prices, exchange rates, distribution costs, taxes, and margins.

segments.src: Sementara itu, BBM subsidi memiliki mekanisme berbeda karena melibatkan keputusan pemerintah dan dukungan anggaran.
segments.tr: Meanwhile, subsidized fuel has a different mechanism because it involves government decisions and budget support.

segments.src: Memahami cara kerja ini membantu masyarakat membaca berita harga energi secara lebih tenang dan menyiapkan anggaran rumah tangga dengan lebih bijak.
segments.tr: Understanding how this works helps the public read energy price news more calmly and prepare household budgets more wisely.

segments.src: *Informasi dalam artikel ini bersifat umum dan dapat berubah.
segments.tr: *Information in this article is general and subject to change.

segments.src: Untuk harga terkini, silakan merujuk ke sumber resmi.*
segments.tr: For the latest prices, please refer to official sources.*

id-20261014-news-3.title: Financial Inclusion Month October 2026: Access to Financial Services Widens, but Citizen Literacy Still Lags

segments.src: Setiap Oktober, Indonesia memperingati Bulan Inklusi Keuangan (BIK).
segments.tr: Every October, Indonesia commemorates Financial Inclusion Month (Bulan Inklusi Keuangan / BIK).

segments.src: Momentum ini biasanya diisi berbagai kegiatan edukasi, pembukaan rekening, hingga promosi layanan keuangan digital.
segments.tr: This momentum is usually filled with various educational activities, account openings, and digital financial service promotions.

segments.src: Namun di balik angka kepemilikan rekening dan pengguna dompet digital yang terus naik, ada pertanyaan penting: apakah masyarakat sudah benar-benar memahami produk yang mereka gunakan?
segments.tr: However, behind the continuously rising numbers of account ownership and digital wallet users, an important question remains: do people truly understand the products they are using?

segments.src: ## Akses naik, pemahaman belum selalu mengikuti
segments.tr: ## Access rises, understanding does not always follow

segments.src: Dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, akses ke layanan keuangan makin mudah.
segments.tr: In recent years, access to financial services has become increasingly easy.

segments.src: Membuka rekening bisa dilakukan lewat ponsel, pembayaran nontunai merambah warung dan pasar tradisional, dan produk asuransi mikro ditawarkan lewat aplikasi.
segments.tr: Opening an account can be done via mobile phones, cashless payments have spread to small shops and traditional markets, and microinsurance products are offered through applications.

segments.src: Survei Nasional Literasi dan Inklusi Keuangan (SNLIK) 2024 yang dirilis OJK bersama BPS mencatat indeks inklusi keuangan sekitar 75 persen, sementara indeks literasi keuangan sekitar 65 persen.
segments.tr: The 2024 National Financial Literacy and Inclusion Survey (SNLIK) released by OJK along with BPS noted a financial inclusion index of around 75 percent, while the financial literacy index was around 65 percent.

segments.src: Selisih sekitar sepuluh poin persentase itu menunjukkan bahwa jumlah orang yang *memakai* layanan keuangan lebih besar daripada jumlah orang yang *memahaminya*.
segments.tr: The gap of about ten percentage points shows that the number of people *using* financial services is larger than the number of people *understanding* them.

segments.src: Perbedaan ini penting.
segments.tr: This distinction is important.

segments.src: Inklusi berarti seseorang memiliki akses dan menggunakan produk keuangan.
segments.tr: Inclusion means a person has access to and uses financial products.

segments.src: Literasi berarti ia mengerti cara kerja, manfaat, biaya, dan risikonya.
segments.tr: Literacy means they understand how they work, their benefits, costs, and risks.

segments.src: Tanpa literasi, akses justru dapat membuka pintu bagi keputusan keliru.
segments.tr: Without literacy, access can actually open the door to mistaken decisions.

segments.src: ## Mengapa kesenjangan ini terjadi?
segments.tr: ## Why does this gap happen?

segments.src: Beberapa faktor yang kerap disebut para pengamat:
segments.tr: Several factors often mentioned by observers:

segments.src: - **Kemudahan yang melampaui edukasi.** Aplikasi dirancang agar cepat dan ringkas, sehingga pengguna sering menekan tombol "setuju" tanpa membaca syarat dan ketentuan.
segments.tr: - **Convenience that surpasses education.** Applications are designed to be fast and concise, so users often click the "agree" button without reading the terms and conditions.

segments.src: - **Informasi produk yang rumit.** Istilah seperti bunga efektif, premi, nilai tunai, atau biaya administrasi tidak selalu dipahami orang awam.
segments.tr: - **Complicated product information.** Terms like effective interest, premiums, cash value, or administrative fees are not always understood by laypeople.

segments.src: - **Kesenjangan wilayah dan usia.** Pemahaman cenderung lebih rendah di daerah yang jauh dari pusat kota, pada kelompok lansia, dan pada sebagian pekerja informal.
segments.tr: - **Regional and age gaps.** Understanding tends to be lower in areas far from city centers, among elderly groups, and among some informal workers.

segments.src: - **Kebiasaan mengikuti orang lain.** Banyak orang membeli produk karena rekomendasi teman atau tokoh di media sosial, bukan karena menilai kebutuhan sendiri.
segments.tr: - **The habit of following others.** Many people buy products because of recommendations from friends or figures on social media, rather than assessing their own needs.

segments.src: ## Risiko penipuan keuangan digital
segments.tr: ## Risks of digital financial fraud

segments.src: Kesenjangan literasi membuat sebagian warga lebih rentan terhadap penipuan.
segments.tr: The literacy gap makes some citizens more vulnerable to fraud.

segments.src: Modus yang umum dilaporkan antara lain:
segments.tr: Commonly reported modus operandi include:

segments.src: 1. **Phishing dan tautan palsu**: pesan yang mengaku dari bank atau dompet digital, lalu meminta pengguna membuka tautan dan memasukkan data.
segments.tr: 1. **Phishing and fake links**: messages claiming to be from a bank or digital wallet, then asking users to open a link and enter data.

segments.src: 2. **Permintaan kode OTP**: pelaku meminta kode verifikasi dengan dalih hadiah, pembaruan data, atau pemblokiran akun.
segments.tr: 2. **OTP code requests**: perpetrators asking for verification codes under the pretext of prizes, data updates, or account blocking.

segments.src: 3. **Penawaran investasi dengan imbal hasil tidak wajar**: janji keuntungan tinggi dan pasti dalam waktu singkat.
segments.tr: 3. **Investment offers with unnatural returns**: promises of high and certain profits in a short time.

segments.src: 4. **Pinjaman online ilegal**: aplikasi tanpa izin yang menarik data kontak dan menagih secara intimidatif.
segments.tr: 4. **Illegal online loans**: unlicensed applications that harvest contact data and collect with intimidation.

segments.src: 5. **Rekayasa sosial**: pelaku berpura-pura sebagai kerabat, petugas, atau layanan pelanggan untuk memancing transfer.
segments.tr: 5. **Social engineering**: perpetrators pretending to be relatives, officers, or customer service to lure transfers.

segments.src: Otoritas terkait terus mengimbau masyarakat untuk berhati-hati, dan layanan pengaduan resmi tersedia bagi korban atau pihak yang menemukan indikasi penipuan.
segments.tr: Related authorities continue to urge the public to be careful, and official complaint services are available for victims or parties finding indications of fraud.

segments.src: ## Langkah praktis bagi warga
segments.tr: ## Practical steps for citizens

segments.src: Meningkatkan literasi tidak harus rumit.
segments.tr: Improving literacy does not have to be complicated.

segments.src: Beberapa kebiasaan sederhana dapat membantu:
segments.tr: Several simple habits can help:

segments.src: - **Jangan pernah membagikan OTP, PIN, atau kata sandi** kepada siapa pun, termasuk yang mengaku petugas resmi.
segments.tr: - **Never share OTP, PINs, or passwords** with anyone, including those claiming to be official officers.

segments.src: - **Pastikan legalitas penyedia layanan.** Periksa apakah lembaga keuangan, platform pinjaman, atau perusahaan investasi terdaftar dan berizin di OJK melalui kanal resmi.
segments.tr: - **Ensure the legality of service providers.** Check whether the financial institution, loan platform, or investment company is registered and licensed with OJK through official channels.

segments.src: - **Hubungi layanan pelanggan lewat nomor atau aplikasi resmi**, bukan lewat tautan atau nomor dari pesan yang tidak dikenal.
segments.tr: - **Contact customer service through official numbers or applications**, not through links or numbers from unknown messages.

segments.src: - **Baca ringkasan produk** sebelum membeli: biaya, jangka waktu, risiko, dan apa yang terjadi bila Anda berhenti di tengah jalan.
segments.tr: - **Read product summaries** before purchasing: fees, time periods, risks, and what happens if you stop midway.

segments.src: - **Waspadai janji untung besar tanpa risiko.** Dalam keuangan, imbal hasil yang tinggi hampir selalu disertai risiko yang tinggi.
segments.tr: - **Beware of promises of big profits without risk.** In finance, high returns are almost always accompanied by high risks.

segments.src: - **Sesuaikan dengan kebutuhan.** Susun anggaran, dana darurat, dan prioritas sebelum memilih produk tabungan, asuransi, atau investasi.
segments.tr: - **Tailor to your needs.** Prepare a budget, emergency funds, and priorities before choosing savings, insurance, or investment products.

segments.src: - **Aktifkan notifikasi transaksi** agar aktivitas mencurigakan cepat terlihat.
segments.tr: - **Enable transaction notifications** so suspicious activity can be quickly spotted.

segments.src: - **Segera laporkan** ke penyedia layanan dan kanal pengaduan resmi bila terjadi transaksi yang tidak dikenali.
segments.tr: - **Immediately report** to service providers and official complaint channels if an unrecognized transaction occurs.

segments.src: ## Peran keluarga, sekolah, dan penyedia layanan
segments.tr: ## The role of families, schools, and service providers

segments.src: Literasi keuangan tidak hanya tanggung jawab individu.
segments.tr: Financial literacy is not just an individual responsibility.

segments.src: Keluarga dapat memulai dengan membiasakan anak mengelola uang saku dan menabung.
segments.tr: Families can start by getting children used to managing pocket money and saving.

segments.src: Sekolah dan kampus dapat memasukkan pengetahuan dasar keuangan ke dalam kegiatan belajar.
segments.tr: Schools and campuses can incorporate basic financial knowledge into learning activities.

segments.src: Sementara itu, penyedia layanan keuangan punya kewajiban menyajikan informasi dengan bahasa yang jelas, transparan soal biaya, dan menyediakan kanal bantuan yang mudah dijangkau.
segments.tr: Meanwhile, financial service providers have an obligation to present information in clear language, be transparent about fees, and provide easily accessible help channels.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Closing

segments.src: Bulan Inklusi Keuangan sebaiknya tidak berhenti pada target jumlah rekening atau pengguna baru.
segments.tr: Financial Inclusion Month should not stop at targets for the number of accounts or new users.

segments.src: Ukuran keberhasilan yang lebih bermakna adalah seberapa banyak warga yang mampu mengambil keputusan keuangan dengan percaya diri dan terlindungi dari penipuan.
segments.tr: A more meaningful measure of success is how many citizens are able to make financial decisions with confidence and be protected from fraud.

segments.src: Akses adalah pintu masuk, sedangkan literasi adalah bekal agar perjalanan di dalamnya aman.
segments.tr: Access is the entrance, while literacy is the provision to make the journey inside safe.

segments.src: *Catatan: Artikel ini bersifat informasi umum dan bukan merupakan nasihat keuangan, investasi, atau hukum.
segments.tr: *Note: This article is for general information and does not constitute financial, investment, or legal advice.

segments.src: Untuk keputusan keuangan pribadi, rujuklah sumber resmi atau konsultasikan dengan pihak yang berwenang.*
segments.tr: For personal financial decisions, refer to official sources or consult with authorized parties.*
